newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - May 9.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
NIHON KEIZAI SHIMBUN:
-- Lower House approves health insurance reform
legislation.
-- Sony Corp posts pre-tax profit of 310 billion
yen in the year to March 31, 1997.
-- Government attempts to boost yen's value against dollar.
YOMIURI SHIMBUN:
-- Cabinet Secretariat to set up panel to screen
appointments of vice ministers and directors general.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and two allies agree on
realignment and privatisation of six government-funded
entities.
ASAHI SHIMBUN:
--LDP administrative reform panel recommends overhaul of
Forestry Agency.
-- Elderly care insurance bill likely to be passed in
current parliament session.
MAINICHI SHIMBUN:
-- Tokyo prosecutors to raid Nomura Securities Co Ltd
over unlawful benefits to racketeer-related firm.
